positioning.zh: 我用 Python 與 TypeScript，製作讓 AI 與數學研究結果可檢查、可重現的工具。
positioning.en: I build Python and TypeScript tools that make AI and mathematical research results inspectable and reproducible.

projects.name: HonestCI
projects.descZh: 檢查綠燈 CI 背後的 JUnit 證據是否新鮮、非空，且符合可信測試基線。
projects.descEn: Checks that the JUnit evidence behind green CI is fresh, non-empty, and consistent with a trusted baseline.

projects.name: RigorGraph
projects.descZh: 把研究主張連到證據，檢查檔案是否改變與審查記錄是否一致，產生離線報告。
projects.descEn: Connect research claims to evidence, audit file integrity and review records, and generate an offline report.

projects.name: Verified Search
projects.descZh: 為 Harness 保留檢索來源與缺口。穩定版提供 verified_search，其他四種擴充工具仍在實驗。
projects.descEn: Retains sources and gaps for Harness. The stable release provides verified_search; four additional tools remain experimental.

projects.name: Finite Witness
projects.descZh: 在有限圖中搜尋反例，保存證書，再用獨立 Python 檢查器重播有限搜尋前綴。
projects.descEn: Search finite graphs for counterexamples, save certificates, and replay the finite search prefix with an independent Python checker.

projects.name: ProofWeave Core
projects.descZh: 把作者提供的結構化證明轉成可檢查的認證流程，並保持形式憑證與語意範圍分離。
projects.descEn: Turns author-supplied structured proofs into inspectable certification runs while separating formal validity from semantic scope.

projects.name: SAIR Proof Press
projects.descZh: Lean 檢查的等式蘊涵求解器公開伴隨站；收錄凍結產物、公開輸入評測與英文論文。
projects.descEn: Public companion to Lean-checked equational implication solvers, with frozen artifacts, released-input evaluation and an English paper.

projects.name: Charlie Alpha 4B
projects.descZh: Apple Silicon 上的三語統計程序選擇模型；公開結果保留 DGP 改善與其他基準未改善的負面結論。
projects.descEn: A trilingual statistical procedure-selection model for Apple Silicon; its public result preserves both DGP gains and benchmark non-improvements.

projects.name: TokenScope
projects.descZh: 調整 attention、取樣與 BPE 的條件，查看實際數值，匯出並重播實驗。
projects.descEn: Change attention, sampling, and BPE controls, inspect the arithmetic, and export or replay an experiment.

projects.name: MiniHarness
projects.descZh: 八步完成一個 Python agent harness，練習工具、錯誤處理與評測。附繁體中文先備課程與 TokenScope 實驗路線。
projects.descEn: Build a Python agent harness in eight steps: tools, recovery, and evaluation. Includes a Traditional Chinese prerequisite curriculum and a TokenScope lab route.

projects.name: DeepSeek Girl
projects.descZh: 共用動畫圖集的兩個宿主版本：Codex 圖集與安裝工具，以及回應 Session 狀態的 Harness 外掛。
projects.descEn: One animation atlas, two host packages: Codex assets and installers, and a session-aware Harness plugin.
